description: Frontier Vitals beats deep-space communication lag via an autonomous, edge-computed health monitor for lunar crews. Running locally on habitat networks, it tracks live biometrics like heart metrics, SpO₂, and stress.
summary: AstroFit is an interactive educational website designed to introduce learners to astronaut fitness and the challenges of maintaining human health in space. The project explores how microgravity affects the human body and why physical exercise, strength, endurance and overall well-being are essential for astronauts during space missions. Through a digital learning experience, AstroFit connects space science with human physiology and fitness education. It aims to make astronaut health concepts accessible to young learners, encourage scientific curiosity and develop awareness about the physical demands of human space exploration. The project highlights the importance of preparing the human body for future missions beyond Earth.
details:
AstroFit is an educational digital platform developed to explore astronaut fitness, human health and the physical challenges associated with space exploration.

How It Works:
The website provides an accessible digital learning experience that introduces users to astronaut fitness and the importance of maintaining physical well-being in microgravity environments.

Benefits and Intended Impact:

  • Increases awareness of the effects of microgravity on the human body.
  • Introduces the importance of astronaut fitness and physical conditioning.
  • Connects scientific concepts with practical fitness education.
  • Encourages interest in STEM subjects and space exploration.
  • Makes astronaut health information accessible to school students.

Creativity and Innovation:
The project combines space science, human physiology and fitness education into one learning platform. It presents astronaut health as an engaging educational subject for young learners.

Tools and Technologies:
The website is hosted on Firebase. The exact programming languages and development tools should be listed according to the technologies used in the actual website.

Factors Considered:
The project considers the physical challenges of microgravity, the importance of regular exercise, astronaut health, accessibility of scientific information and the educational needs of students.

Future Scope:
AstroFit can be expanded with interactive fitness challenges, educational quizzes, astronaut training simulations and additional space-health learning resources.
